subject: general
question: Which among the following terms means growing of fruits?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pomiculture.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pomiculture** refers to the cultivation of** fruit-bearing trees and plants.**
 
• **Apiculture **is the practice of **beekeeping, **which involves the maintenance of **bee colonies** for the purpose of **honey production.**
 
• **Arboriculture** is the **cultivation, management, **and study of **trees, shrubs, and other woody plants**. 
 
• **Sericulture** is the rearing of **silkworms** for the production of silk.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pomiculture** is derived from the Latin word **"pomum," **which means** fruit.**

 
 
• The fruits that are commonly grown through pomiculture include** apples, pears, peaches, plums, and cherries.**
 
 
 
• **Apiculture** is important for **pollination of crops and plants**, in addition to honey production.
 
• **Arboriculture** involves the **care and maintenance of trees **and shrubs in urban, suburban, and rural areas.
 
• **Sericulture** is an important industry in countries like** China, India, and Japan, **where silk production has a long history.
